programs.title: Joshila Janbaz
programs.desc: Bhagvathi, a tea vendor, has big dreams for his younger brother, Guna. However, Guna gets killed by his girlfriend's father, who is unaware that his daughter is pregnant.

programs.title: EMI Liya Hai To Chukana Padega
programs.desc: A film that tells the story of a group of people who fall prey to credit card debt and are struggling to repay their loans. They come together to form a support group and devise a plan to fight against the corrupt practices of the credit card companies. The movie highlights the consequences of reckless spending and the importance of financial literacy in an engaging and thought-provoking plot.

programs.title: Time Pass
programs.desc: TIME PASS tells the story of a college student Vishal [Arjun Punj], who develops a passion towards Jenny [Mona Chopra]. In fact, Jenny also happens to be his family friend. Vishal is possessed with the idea of making love to Jenny.

programs.title: The Murderer
programs.desc: A hotel musician's life takes a turn for the unexpected after his admirer's presumed suicide. Considered a prime suspect himself, he does some investigation and comes to realize that the case is far more twisted than it appeared.
